description: Lists the tags of a WinCC Unified HMI as {hmi, table, tags:[{name, table, tagType, dataType, connection, plcName, plcTag, address, accessMode, acquisitionMode, acquisitionCycle}], total, nextCursor, inventoryGaps}, every value text or null. Use it to see what exists before creating, updating or deleting a tag or an alarm. An internal tag has connection, plcName, plcTag, address, accessMode, acquisitionMode and acquisitionCycle all null (TIA reads its connection back as a placeholder such as <Internal tag>, which the serve answers as null); an external tag names its connection and the PLC tag or address it reads. `table` limits the list to one tag table (an unknown table is 404 not_found) and is echoed back, null when not given. For a large HMI read it in pages: pass limit (1-1000), then pass the nextCursor of each page as cursor until nextCursor is null; total is the number of tags of the whole list. Without limit and cursor the whole list is returned with nextCursor null. A cursor of a list that changed is 409 cursor_stale (restart without cursor), one that is not a nextCursor is 400 invalid_cursor. `inventoryGaps` [{kind, subject, reason}] lists every value or object the serve could not read while building the answer (empty when all reads succeeded): the unreadable value is null and one gap names it, so a null next to a gap means unreadable, while a value the object does not offer is null without a gap. Needs an open project and a WinCC Unified HMI (hmi = its name from tia_hmis, matched ignoring case): a classic WinCC HMI is refused with 409 hmi_not_unified, an unknown HMI is 404 not_found and two HMIs with the same name are 409 ambiguous_name. Maps to GET /hmi/{hmi}/tags?table=&limit=&cursor= (all optional). Read-only (class R).

cursor.description: the nextCursor of the previous page, passed back exactly as received; it is opaque, so never invent, build or edit one (omit it for the first page, and omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

hmi.description: HMI name, as listed by tia_hmis (a WinCC Unified HMI)

limit.description: page size, an integer from 1 to 1000; pass it to read the list in pages (omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

table.description: only the tags of this tag table (from tia_hmi_tag_tables); omit for every table

name: tia_hmi_tags
title: TIA — HMI Unified tags
